name: resume-stack
description: A simple alternative(?) to InlineJS for transaction resumption alone with dark mode support

scripts.demo: npm run build && cp dist/index.js demo/resume-stack.js && cd demo && python server.py
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && git tag v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git add package.json package-lock.json && git commit -m "release: v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push && git push origin --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && git tag v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git add package.json package-lock.json && git commit -m "release: v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push && git push origin --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && git tag v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && git add package.json package-lock.json && git commit -m "release: v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push && git push origin --tags

author: Afam-Ifediogor, U. Divine
